name: memberjunction-distribution
description: MemberJunction distribution monorepo - includes MJAPI, MJExplorer, and code generation tools

scripts.prebuild: node -e "try { require.resolve('turbo') } catch (e) { console.error('\n❌ Dependencies not installed. Run: pnpm install (or npm install)\n'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.postinstall: echo 'MemberJunction installation complete. Please configure your environment using install.config.json or mj.config.cjs before proceeding.'
scripts.setup: echo 'Please run the mj:migrate, mj:codegen, and build scripts with your package manager.'
